meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Chat SDK 桥接 GitHub，参与 PR 和 issue 的评论线程。被 @ 时回复；首次 @ 后，该线程的后续评论也都会回复。
howto.when: 当收到已配置仓库的 Webhook 评论事件，且评论中 @ 了与 GITHUB_BOT_USERNAME 完全一致的机器人用户名时触发；首次 @ 后，该线程后续评论也会触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 GitHub 频道集成。
say.note: 开始执行复制适配器、注册等步骤。

say.text: 仓库是私有的，请继续配置 GitHub。
接入 GitHub，仓库是公开的。
say.note: 使用 strict 策略并提示添加成员。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude bridges GitHub through the Chat SDK. It joins PR and issue comment threads, replies when @-mentioned, and keeps responding to follow-up comments after the first mention.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a webhook event arrives for a comment in a configured repo's PR or issue and the comment mentions the exact bot username. After the first mention, the thread is subscribed and subsequent comments also trigger.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel integration for me.
say_en.note: Runs the apply steps: copy adapter, register, install.

say_en.text: The repo is private; continue configuring GitHub.
say_en.note: Sets unknown_sender_policy to public for private repo.

say_en.text: Integrate GitHub; the repo is public.
say_en.note: Uses strict policy and prompts to add members.
